summary:
林德本季EPS低於預期13.51%，營收年增資料缺失，獲利端出現少見壓力。
• EPS 3.26美元，低於預期3.77美元，負向驚喜13.51%
• 營收8.76億美元規模與上季相近，需求面尚屬穩定
• 工業氣體長約結構仍提供現金流可預測性
ai_view:
訊號偏負向：對一向穩健的林德而言，13.51%的EPS不及預期屬於異常，市場會審視是否為一次性項目、匯率或特定地區量價走弱所致。短期股價恐承壓並引發評價重估討論；中期須觀察管理層是否重申全年指引。追蹤指標：調整後EPS與一次性項目拆解、匯率影響、各事業群利潤率，以及後續季度是否回到正常超標軌道以重建信心。

需留意：EPS明顯不及預期，須釐清是否含一次性費用或匯率拖累；營收年增資料缺失，成長能見度下降；本益比34.81在獲利失速下評價風險升高

summary_en:
Linde missed EPS by 13.51% this quarter, with revenue YoY unavailable, showing rare earnings pressure.
• EPS of $3.26 missed the $3.77 estimate, a 13.51% negative surprise
• Revenue of $8.76B was broadly in line with the prior quarter, suggesting stable demand
• Long-term contract structure still offers cash-flow predictability

ai_view_en:
Signal is mildly negative: for a typically steady operator like Linde, a 13.51% EPS miss is unusual, and the market will scrutinize whether it stems from one-off items, FX, or regional volume/price weakness. Near-term the stock may face pressure and prompt valuation debate; mid-term hinges on whether management reaffirms full-year guidance. Track: adjusted EPS and one-off bridge, FX impact, segment margins, and whether subsequent quarters return to the normal beat cadence to rebuild confidence.

Watch：The clear EPS miss requires clarity on one-off charges or FX drag; Missing revenue YoY reduces growth visibility; A 34.81x P/E raises valuation risk if earnings stall
beat_or_miss: 低於預期：EPS 3.26顯著低於預期3.77（-13.51%）。
